name: Nordstrand (synthetic island polygon)
note: Nordstrand has no island polygon in OSM (only place=village and natural=peninsula nodes; it is a peninsula now, so the coastline does not close around it), and the municipality relation's interior point lies 2 km north-west of the village. OpenMapTiles labels place=island NODES only from z12, so the injector adds a synthetic 50 km² square (roughly the real area, which sets OMT's rank and first zoom) for the row's own object, the municipality relation, centred on lat/lon = the village node's position; Planetiler labels a polygon at its interior point = the centre, and the search entry lies there too. It carries the relation's names, in every dialect, and is e Strönj's only label, at every zoom, like Pellworm's: the village node shows no label (row below), and Nordstrand's parts are labelled beneath the island (#174)

name: Ääderstää (synthetic landscape polygon)
note: Eiderstedt is a peninsula: OSM has a natural=peninsula node and the Amt boundary, and OpenMapTiles labels neither. As for Nordstrand, a synthetic square of about the real area (340 km², which gets the label from z8) centred on the peninsula node carries its names through z10; it needs frasch:kind=landscape here (the square inherits only names and frasch:ref) to be drawn by the style's place-landscape layer, before the villages crowd the peninsula
